items.question: What are the four things assessed in the three-vessel view?
options: Number, size, alignment and arrangement of the vessels
Rate, rhythm, axis and size of the heart
Colour, power, pulsed-wave and continuous-wave Doppler
Atria, ventricles, septum and valves
items.explanation: The three-vessel view is assessed for vessel number, size, alignment and arrangement.

items.question: From fetal left to right, what is the normal order of the three vessels?
options: Pulmonary artery, aorta, superior vena cava
Aorta, pulmonary artery, superior vena cava
Superior vena cava, aorta, pulmonary artery
Pulmonary artery, superior vena cava, aorta
items.explanation: From left to right: pulmonary artery, aorta, right superior vena cava.

items.question: How do the vessel diameters normally compare in the three-vessel view?
options: They decrease from left to right
They increase from left to right
All three are equal
The vena cava is the largest
items.explanation: Diameters decrease from left to right: pulmonary artery largest, superior vena cava smallest.

items.question: In the normal three-vessel-and-trachea view, where do the two arches lie?
options: Both to the left of the trachea, meeting in a V
One on each side of the trachea
Both to the right of the trachea
In front of the trachea, running parallel
items.explanation: The ductus arteriosus and aortic arch both run to the left of the trachea and meet at an acute angle (V shape).

items.question: How is the trachea recognised in this plane?
options: A bright ring around a small fluid-filled space
A solid bright dot
A large dark circle bigger than the aorta
It cannot be seen on ultrasound
items.explanation: The trachea appears as a bright ring around a small fluid-filled space.

items.question: Besides the V-sign, what does the screening checklist ask for at the three-vessel-and-trachea view?
options: Ductal and aortic arches of similar size
An aortic arch twice the size of the ductal arch
Four vessels in a row
Pulsed-wave Doppler of both arches
items.explanation: The checklist asks for the V-sign with both arches left of the trachea, and arches of similar size.

items.question: For which group of abnormalities is the three-vessel-and-trachea view particularly useful?
options: Aortic arch abnormalities such as coarctation and vascular rings
Atrioventricular valve offset
Abdominal situs
Pericardial effusion
items.explanation: It is particularly useful for arch abnormalities such as coarctation, vascular rings and aberrant right subclavian artery.

items.question: Which venous anomaly do the three-vessel views help to detect?
options: Persistent left superior vena cava
Absent ductus venosus
Umbilical vein varix
Hepatic vein thrombosis
items.explanation: These views help detect anomalies of the systemic veins, including persistent left superior vena cava.

items.question: The four-chamber view is normal. In complete transposition, which view is typically abnormal?
options: The three-vessel view
The upper-abdomen view
None of the axial views
Only the sagittal views
items.explanation: Lesions such as complete transposition can have a seemingly normal four-chamber view but are typically abnormal in the three-vessel view.

items.question: An anomaly is found on the three-vessel-and-trachea view. Which of these is an example of how that can change management?
options: It can prompt testing for 22q11 microdeletion
It removes the need for fetal echocardiography
It means the anomaly scan need not be completed
It has no effect on counselling
items.explanation: Findings on the three-vessel views can prompt 22q11 testing, change the planned place of delivery, and prepare the team for prostaglandin or airway problems.

items.question: Both arches cannot be shown in one true axial plane. Why might that be?
options: The aortic arch lies slightly nearer the head than the ductal arch
One arch must be absent
The trachea hides the aortic arch
The arches are only visible in the third trimester
items.explanation: The aortic arch is more cranial than the ductal arch, so showing both together may need a slight adjustment away from a true axial plane.
